title: Riser Base User's Manual
body_html:
Overview

The OneLaser Riser Base is a structural accessory designed to elevate a laser machine, creating additional clearance and enabling thicker workpieces or specialized fixtures. The riser base is assembled from a collection of sheet-metal panels, support brackets, reinforcing plates, and connecting strips. The manual presents labeled components (A-Q; 1-6) together with eight major assembly steps.

 

Prepare and identify all components

  1. Open the packaging of all components and place them on a clean work surface.
  2. Identify all components shown in the manual:
  • A~Q:

● (A) Left rear support

● (B) Left front support

● (C) Right rear support

● (D) Right front support

● (E) Left side panel

● (F) Right side panel

● (G) Left tray support plate

● (H) Right tray support plate

● (I) Left connecting strip

● (J) Right connecting strip

● (K) Rear panel

● (L) Front panel

● (M) Rear connecting strip

● (N) Front connecting strip

● (O) Reinforcing strip A

● (P) Reinforcing strip B

● (Q) Reinforcing plate

  • 1~6:

● Flat head hex socket head cap screw M3*8 (×10)

● Flat head hex socket head cap screw M4*10 (×20)

● Cylindrical head hex socket head cap screw M3*8 (×8)

● Cylindrical head hex socket head cap screw M4*8 (×8)

● Cylindrical head hex socket head cap screw M4*10 (×6) 

● Cylindrical head hex socket head cap screw M4*12 (×8) 

● Wrench (×3)

  3. Refer to the diagram to confirm the orientation of the panel and structural components.

 

Assembly — Step-by-Step Instructions

Step 1 - Assemble the Left and Right Pallet Support Plates

Use M3*8 (×10) flathead hex screws and a suitable wrench.

Assemble the left pallet support plate with the left connecting strip, and the right pallet support plate with the right connecting strip.

 

Step 2 - Assemble the Left Panel and Support Components

Use M4*8 (×4) socket head cap screws and a suitable wrench.

Assemble the left panel with the left front and rear support components.

 

Step 3 - Assemble the Left Panel and Left Pallet Support Plate

Use M4*10 (×10) flat head hex screws and a suitable wrench.

Assemble the assembled left panel assembly with the left pallet support plate.

 

Step 4 - Assemble the Right Side Panel and Support Components

Use M4*8 (×4) socket head cap screws and a suitable wrench.

Assemble the right side panel with the front and rear right side support components.

 

Step 5 - Assemble the Right Side Panel and Right Tray Support Plate

Use M4*10 (×10) flat head hex screws and a suitable wrench.

Assemble the assembled right side panel with the right tray support plate.

 

Step 6 - Assemble the Reinforcing Plate and Reinforcing Strips

Use M4*10 (×6) socket head cap screws and a suitable wrench.

Assemble the reinforcing plate with reinforcing strips A and B.

 

Step 7 - Assemble the Overall Frame

Use M4*12 (×8) socket head cap screws and a suitable wrench.

Assemble the previously assembled left and right side components, reinforcing plate, and front and rear panels according to the diagram.

 

Step 8 - Assemble the Front and Rear Connecting Strips

Use M3*8 (×8) socket head cap screws and a suitable wrench.

Assemble the front and rear connecting strips in the corresponding positions on the top of the front and rear panels, as shown in the diagram.

 

Assembly complete!

 

Final Check — Assembly Completed

Verify all screws are tightened.

Confirm that all panels are flush and that the riser base stands level.

Confirm tray support alignment.

 

Safety & Best Practices

Assemble on a flat surface to ensure correct alignment.

Do not fully tighten screws until all major parts are hooked in place.

Handle sheet-metal edges carefully to avoid cuts.

After assembly, check for any resonant wobble and re-tighten connections.

 

Troubleshooting

Panel does not align:
→ Loosen surrounding screws, realign, re-tighten.

Tray support uneven:
→ Reinstall G and H plates, ensure horizontal alignment before tightening.

Base feels unstable:
→ Check reinforcing strips O, P, and the Q plate.
